title: Subset Node Anomaly Tracking over Large Dynamic Graphs

problem.claim: Track a targeted subset of nodes in an evolving graph.

gap.claim: Existing edge-oriented methods do not quantify how individual nodes change over time, while whole-graph representation methods are computationally inefficient.

narrative_sequence.summary: Tracking a targeted subset of nodes in evolving graphs is important for real-world applications.
Existing methods typically identify anomalous edges or anomalous graph snapshots in a stream.
These methods either cannot quantify individual node changes over time or require maintaining whole-graph representations continuously, causing computational inefficiency.

unknowns: The proposed method or system is not described.
No experiments, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results are provided.
The targeted node subset and anomaly definition are unspecified.
